title: Centralizer Realization of Cartan Subalgebras in $L^*$-Algebras
statement: Is every Cartan subalgebra of a simple $L^*$-algebra the centralizer of one of its elements?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Infinite Dimensional Lie Theory (2011), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2010/51, pp. 2977--3042](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2010/51)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The report records this centralizer question for simple L-star algebras as an open problem. Existing classifications of Cartan subalgebras do not prove the asserted centralizer property in general.

**Sources checked.**

- [original OWR report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2010/51)
